about: 2026-11-22 guestref (research, the coordinator's follow-up): a Guest Referee match started through the game's own MENUS, Regular (qa_reg 4 + 32768: Multi Play > Guest Referee > Single Match > PLAYER 1P vs CPU > ARENA > RULES > the select: Austin for the player, The Rock for the CPU, the third pick the box along -- the guest referee, the computer's), not the QA demo set-up. 20 s into the match the CPU plays the player's man too, so all three are the computer's. The question: does the computer referee count a pin (state 166, the count on the HUD) and does the match end? The match's own flags and roles as the menus make them (flags & 0x81400 == 0x81400).

expect.name: a Guest Referee match through the menus: match flags 0x80000 with the singles bits 0x1400, three men
expect.check: mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 120 and (flags & 0x81400) == 0x81400 and s2_id != 0xFFFF

expect.name: the guest referee (slot 2) is no side of the match (+0xE9 0x10 clear) and the computer's
expect.check: mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 120 and (s2_e1 & 0x10) == 0 and s2_pad == 0

expect.name: a pin happened (a man in 69 / 75)
expect.check: mode == -2 and (s0_phase == 69 or s0_phase == 75 or s1_phase == 69 or s1_phase == 75)

expect.name: the computer referee counted a pin (state 166)
